decls.name: ArithContent
decls.statement:
structure ArithContent (C : Type u) [AddCommMonoid C] (E : Type w) [Monoid E]
    (act : E → (C →+ C)) (R : Type*) [CommRing R] where
  /-- the prime-indexed operators, ring endomorphisms of the arithmetic structure -/
  psi : ℕ → (R →+* R)
  /-- the index acts through the MULTIPLICATIVE monoid: `ψ₁ = id` -/
  psi_one : ∀ x : R, psi 1 x = x
  /-- `ψ_p ψ_q = ψ_{pq}` -/
  psi_mul : ∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x : R, psi (m * n) x = psi m (psi n x)
  /-- **THE FROBENIUS-LIFT CRITERION.**  `ψ_p(x) ≡ x^p (mod p)`, stated as divisibility in `R`.
  Expressibility and satisfaction; no order, no sign, no positivity. -/
  frobenius : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ∀ x : R, (p : R) ∣ (psi p x - x ^ p)
  /-- the index map into the specification's acting monoid -/
  idx : ℕ → E
  /-- the arithmetic structure sits inside the class object -/
  link : R →+ C
  /-- **EQUIVARIANCE — the binding field.**  The specification's action, restricted along the
  link, IS the arithmetic action.  Without this the ring could be decoration. -/
  equivariant : ∀ p : ℕ, ∀ x : R, (act (idx p)) (link x) = link (psi p x)
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

    intro h

  arch_independent := ⟨((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℝ)), ((0 : ℤ), (1 : ℝ)), rfl, by
    intro h

  act := fun _ => AddMonoidHom.id (ℤ × ℝ)
  act_one := fun _ => rfl
  act_mul := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  pair := fun _ _ => 0
  pair_add_left := fun _ _ _ => (zero_add 0).symm

decls.name: CarrierSpec
decls.statement:
structure CarrierSpec (C : Type u) [AddCommMonoid C] (F : Type v) [AddCommMonoid F]
    (E : Type w) [Monoid E] (P : Type*) [AddCommMonoid P] [PartialOrder P] where
  /-- **(R1) THE DOOR PREDICATE — cancellativity.**  MODEL of the external criterion: the
  symmetrization construction works exactly on *simplifiable* semigroups.  This single field is
  what excludes the entire characteristic-one / tropical class (see `no_idempotent_candidate`). -/
  cancel : ∀ a b c : C, a + c = b + c → a = b
  /-- **(R2a) SIGNED — the negation map.**  MODEL: classes must carry signs for a pairing to
  have anything to be definite *about*. -/
  neg : C → C
  /-- **(R2b) SIGNED — the inverse law.** -/
  add_neg : ∀ a : C, a + neg a = 0
  /-- **(R3a) THE FINITE-PLACE COMPONENT.**  MODEL of the ℤ-coefficients at finite places. -/
  finPart : C →+ F
  /-- **(R3b) THE ARCHIMEDEAN COMPONENT, ℝ-VALUED.**  MODEL of `a_∞ ∈ ℝ`.  Present as a
  *founding coordinate*, not as an import deferred to later: both external arrests (Borger's
  *"nothing about the archimedean place"*, Connes' trace living only there) say the ∞-place
  cannot be bolted on afterwards. -/
  archPart : C →+ ℝ
  /-- **(R3c) THE TWO COMPONENTS SEE EVERYTHING.** -/
  components_faithful : ∀ a : C, finPart a = 0 → archPart a = 0 → a = 0
  /-- **(R3d) SCAFFOLDING — RETAINED, DEFECTIVE, AND LABELLED AS SUCH.**

decls.name: TECHNEType
decls.statement:
inductive TECHNEType where
  | type_I    -- specified + closed + fully enumerable (admits direct proof)
  | type_II   -- specified + closed + partially enumerable (staged resolution)
  | type_III  -- specified + open (modifications change behavior)
  | type_D    -- not specified
decls.subject: ARITHMETIC-OR-LOGIC

decls.name: techneClassify
decls.statement:
def techneClassify (p : ProblemClassification) : TECHNEType :=
  if !p.fully_specified then .type_D
  else if !p.closed then .type_III
  else if p.fully_enumerable then .type_I
  else .type_II
decls.subject: PROGRAMME-TYPE

decls.name: ImpossibilitySubtype
decls.statement:

  | II_A          -- κ = 0 mutually conjugate (Heisenberg uncertainty)
  | II_B          -- κ undefined, self-reference loop (Gödel incompleteness)
  | II_C          -- κ = 0 for all I, topological obstruction (Hairy-ball)
  | II_D          -- κ = 0 for some I, specific dark interface (Sieve ceiling)
  | not_TYPE_II   -- subtype only meaningful for TYPE II systems
